ki.$description: Touch density (spec 045 Amendment A1): one +4px step (medium controls 40 -> 44px), 44 x 44 CSS px pointer targets (WCAG 2.5.5, Apple HIG), container spacing at the default step. Declared with data-ki-density="touch" on any element; opt-in only, never applied by a coarse pointer.

control-offset.$description: Controls and rows 4px taller (40 -> 44 in onmars, 48 -> 52 for material3 fields); icon buttons keep their size.

target-min.$description: Every interactive target reaches 44 x 44 CSS px; small controls extend their target without painting more.
